description: This file defines an abstract base class `HTMLPurifier_Node` for nodes in an HTML purification library. It provides common properties like line, column, armor, and dead flag, and requires subclasses to implement the `toTokenPair()` method. It serves as a foundational class for representing nodes within the HTML purification process.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node
classes.description: An abstract base class for all node types in the HTMLPurifier library, providing common properties and requiring subclasses to implement token conversion.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: Abstract method to return a pair of start and end tokens representing this node, excluding children.
